jobs.title: Behavioral Health Clinical Operations Manager - MD Live - Remote
jobs.why: Exceptional behavioral-health operations match: leads clinical operations programs, referral/care-coordination workflows, scalable process design, performance metrics, people development, onboarding/training and cross-functional work with Operations, Product and Tech. Kevin’s ABA operations, intake, training and workflow-improvement experience maps directly to the core work.
jobs.gap: The posting favors deeper healthcare-operations tenure and prior people/program leadership; Kevin should quantify operational ownership, training leadership and measurable workflow improvements without overstating clinical credentials.

jobs.title: Regional Practice Manager – Multi-Site Healthcare Operations
jobs.why: Strong local healthcare-operations fit overseeing staff, provider schedules, documentation workflows, productivity, patient flow and operational consistency across Brooklyn and Queens. Kevin’s ABA operations, staffing, intake and workflow background is highly relevant.
jobs.gap: This is a senior multi-site practice-management role and prefers prior direct medical-practice and multi-office leadership; Kevin should position his cross-borough ABA operations experience carefully and quantify staff/process ownership.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare-tech implementation role owning customer launches from kickoff through steady state, multi-stakeholder project plans, customer communication and improvements to the implementation playbook. Strong match for Kevin’s systems, onboarding, training and cross-functional project work.
jobs.gap: Requires working knowledge of clinical data and stronger technical implementation fluency than Kevin has demonstrated; emphasize healthcare workflows, Salesforce/Power Apps/process design and foundational technical literacy without overstating SQL.

jobs.title: Platform Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare SaaS transition role centered on enterprise implementations, project planning, cross-functional coordination, client engagement, reporting, risk management and process improvement. Kevin’s systems/project-management work aligns with the operating model.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 3–5 years of enterprise software implementation plus healthcare integrations such as Epic/Cerner and data integration experience; this is a meaningful technical stretch.

jobs.title: Marketplace Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Healthcare operations role owning client-program performance, staffing/roster health, operational playbooks, client launches, credentialing readiness, cross-functional onboarding and continuous improvement. Kevin’s healthcare operations and regulated-workforce experience is relevant.
jobs.gap: Wheel expects hands-on SQL, Looker and marketplace/SLA analytics. Kevin should present SQL only as foundational/working knowledge, making this a reach despite strong healthcare-operations overlap.
